claims.text: Hearth and Hamlet is developed by Phorust Studios and the current Steam listing names Runic Forge and Gamersky Games as publishers.
The announced full release date for Hearth and Hamlet is August 19, 2026.
An official Hearth and Hamlet demo launched on Steam on April 20, 2026.
Hearth and Hamlet is an incremental medieval city builder built around gathering resources, assigning workers, constructing buildings and steadily growing a settlement.
Official descriptions include policies and laws, permanent research, magic and alchemy, trade with neighboring kingdoms and soldier recruitment.
The official feature list names food, wood, stone and gold among the resources workers can gather.
The current full-game Steam page publishes system requirements for Windows and Linux/SteamOS.
No verified official browser/HTML5 runtime was found for Hearth and Hamlet in the official Steam distribution or the developer's itch.io listing during this build.
